---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability or an improvement to an existing one
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Is your feature request related to a problem?

A clear description of the problem or limitation. For example: "I'm always frustrated when [...]".

## Describe the solution you'd like

What you want to happen. Be concrete about the expected behaviour, the API shape, or the UI change.

## Describe alternatives you've considered

Other approaches you thought about, including workarounds you are using today, and why they fall short.

## Which part of the system does this touch?

- [ ] Backend API
- [ ] Scoring engine or recurrence logic
- [ ] ETL / data ingestion
- [ ] Dashboard (React/Vite)
- [ ] Docker / deployment
- [ ] Documentation

## Data or domain considerations

If this affects the scoring model, BIS IS 10500 limits, district coverage, or the recurrence logic, explain the domain reasoning. Note whether the change alters existing risk scores or band assignments, since those are reported figures in the project.

## Additional context

Mockups, prior art, links to related issues, or references from the WQMIS / JJM / BIS documentation.
